SourceRef.description: A place in one source: the source's id and an anchor in its own identifiers.

anchor.description: The place in the source, for example 'para:7.1'
anchor.title: Anchor

source_id.description: The id of the source record
source_id.title: Source Id

SourceRef.title: SourceRef

description:
Something the sources do not settle, written as a question one named role can answer.

The id is derived from the subject and the question text, so a rebuild asks the same question
under the same id and an earlier answer still attaches to it.

about.description: The source unit the question concerns

ask_role.description: The role to ask, for example 'Head of Third-Party Risk'
ask_role.title: Ask Role

cites.description: The facts and units the question rests on
cites.title: Cites

decision_id.description: The person's decision that answered or closed the question
decision_id.title: Decision Id

priority.description: The order of review; a low priority never removes a question from the register
priority.title: Priority

question.description: The question as it would be put to the person, answerable in one reply
question.title: Question

reason.description: Why the question is open, from the closed list
reason.title: Reason

why_unknown.description: What was looked for, where, and what was found
why_unknown.title: Why Unknown

title: OpenQuestion
